minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  April 27, 2021

  The Parking Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
  Tuesday, April 27, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

  Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
  City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking
  Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:01 p.m.

  The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Parking
  Authority Secretary/ Joint Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
  quorum as follows:

  Present: Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman Parking
  Authority Chairman /Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts, Council
  Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/ Parking
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and
  Faulk; and
  Absent: None.

  City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint Powers Authority
  officials and personnel present were as follows:

  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

  * Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking Authority,
  and Joint Powers Authority.

  PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/
  Housing Authority Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers Authority
  Chairman inquired if there were any persons who wished to address the City
  Council/Successor Agency/ Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint Power
  Authority on any item on the Agendas.

  Shannon Gibson commented on Agenda Item No. O-1, an Ordinance amending Chapter 8,
  Articles 9 and 10, and Chapter 2, Article 3 of the Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Caller (Name Unknown) commented on Warrants and Bills, Agenda Item Nos. 2, 3, 5, 6,
  10, and O-1.

  Bob McLaughlin, commented on Agenda Item No. O-1, an Ordinance amending Chapter
  8, Articles 9 and 10, and Chapter 2, Article 3 of the Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Gil Mathieu, District 4, commented on Warrants and Bills, and Agenda Item No. O-1, an
  Ordinance amending Chapter 8, Articles 9 and 10, and Chapter 2, Article 3 of the
  Inglewood Municipal Code.

  Caller (Name Unknown), second district, commented on Agenda Item No. O-1, an
  Ordinance amending Chapter 8, Articles 9 and 10, and Chapter 2, Article 3 of the
  Inglewood Municipal Code.

  City Clerk, Aisha L. Thompson, received emails regarding Agenda Item No. O-1, an
  Ordinance amending Chapter 8, Articles 9 and 10, and Chapter 2, Article 3 of the
  Inglewood Municipal Code. She also stated copies of the emails were provided to the
  Council, City Attorney, and City Manager.

142.9  PAYMENT OF WARRANTS AND BILLS. It was moved by Council Member/
  Successor Agency Member / Housing Authority Member Morales, and seconded by
 April 27, 2021

  Council Member/Successor Agency Member/Housing Authority Member Dotson that the
  demands presented to the City Council/Successor Agency/ Housing Authority dated April
  23, 2021, in the amount of $3,072,024.78 are hereby allowed, and the City Clerk/
  Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority Secretary is hereby authorized to certify
  upon said registers that said demands are approved. The motion was carried by the
  following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Council Members/Successor Agency Members/Housing Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Parking Authority Member Padilla, and seconded by
  Parking Authority Member Dotson that the Minutes for the Parking Authority Meeting
  held on July 28, 2020, be reconsidered. The motion was carried by the following roll call
  vote:
  Ayes: Parking Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts; and
  Noes: None.

  It was moved by Parking Authority Member Morales, and seconded by Parking Authority
  Member Dotson that the Minutes for the Parking Authority Meeting held on July 28,
  2020, be approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Parking Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Parking Authority
  Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Abstain: Parking Authority Member Faulk.

  There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts declared the meeting
  adjourned in honor of Willie Agee, at the hour of 3:16 p.m.

  Approved this 14th day of September, 2021.

  _________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

  ________________________
  James Butts, Jr., Chairman
